lines.en: Scratch the surface with my scales.
My tail crackles as I swim.
Feel the faint vibrations on the surface.

lines.zh: 用触须探索周围的水域。
lines.en: Use my whiskers to explore the water.

lines.zh: 用尾巴拍打水面赶走干扰。
lines.en: Swat away disturbances with my tail.
Watch for movements at the bottom.
White scales lead. One red spot follows.
I circle once under the blossom shade.
Feel the subtle changes in the water.
Observe the reflections on the surface.

lines.zh: 红顶浮在水面像颗樱桃。
lines.en: My red crown floats like a cherry on the water.
A petal falls, and I slip aside.
One flick, and the reflection breaks.
I sun that red patch in the shallows.

lines.zh: 我抬起红顶，露出水面看你。
lines.en: I lift my red crown above the surface to look at you.
Prepare to attack the nearby player.
The tancho's red is fixed on you.
Swim towards the player to attack.
I look up at you, mouth opening and closing.

lines.zh: 你影子落水，我就不动了。
lines.en: Your shadow hits the water and I freeze.
You step closer. I back off half a block.
I watch the fishing rod in your hand.
You crouch down, and I expect food.
I look at you, then at the surface.

lines.zh: 水里的倒影让我缩了一下。

lines.en: Someone on the bank. I swim around.

lines.zh: 我头顶的红，被敲得发疼。
lines.en: The red on my head throbs from the blow.
A white scale lifts. My red crown is askew.

lines.zh: 鱼饵在眼前晃动，我却毫不在意。
lines.en: Bait dances before me, but I'm not tempted.

lines.zh: 这些食物都属于我，不是你们的。
lines.en: These meals are mine, not yours.

lines.zh: 我的花纹如此美丽，你也会被吸引。
lines.en: My patterns are beautiful, and so are you.

lines.zh: 锦鲤的荣耀属于我，不是你。
lines.en: The glory of koi is mine, not yours.

lines.zh: 不要试图靠近我，危险重重。
lines.en: Stay away from me, danger lurks.

lines.zh: 我的游动令水面泛起涟漪。
lines.en: My movement causes ripples on the water.

lines.zh: 我的花纹可以吓退敌人。
我比你们更适应这里的环境。
lines.en: I'm more adapted to this environment.

lines.zh: 不要试图抓住我，我是唯一的。
lines.en: Don't try to catch me, I'm the only one.

lines.zh: 水中的碰撞让我更警惕。
lines.en: Collisions in the water make me more alert.
I avoid when I hit a stone.

lines.zh: 我的速度可以避开危险。
碰撞不会改变我的方向。

lines.en: I use collisions to find food.

lines.zh: 水中的碰撞让我更加灵活。
lines.en: Collisions in water make me more flexible.

lines.zh: 碰撞只是我游泳的一部分。
lines.en: Collisions are part of my swimming.

lines.zh: 我的体型让碰撞显得微不足道。
我的存在让碰撞成为常态。
找到伴侣，我的生活更精彩。
lines.en: Finding a mate makes my life more colorful.

lines.zh: 我的花纹让伴侣更美丽。
lines.en: My patterns make my partner more beautiful.
I'm selective in choosing a partner.

lines.zh: 我的花纹有助于吸引伴侣。
与我同类的才会是最佳伴侣。
lines.en: Only my kind are the best partners.

lines.zh: 我的存在让这个世界更完整。
lines.en: My presence makes this world complete.

lines.zh: 找到伴侣，我们的生命更精彩。
lines.en: Finding a partner makes our lives more colorful.

lines.zh: 我的花纹和你相得益彰。
我的伴侣是我一生的挚爱。
lines.en: My partner is my lifelong love.

lines.zh: 我头顶那点红，你看见了吗？
lines.en: Do you see the red patch on my head?
Flicker in water like night stars.
Avoid me, and you'll regret it.

lines.zh: 沉底的果实，我用嘴推了推。
lines.en: I push the sunken fruit with my mouth.

lines.zh: 面包屑一落，我立刻转头。
lines.en: A crumb falls, and my head turns at once.
The single red spot on my head is aimed at you.
I chase a petal all the way to the bank.
I fix on a bug that fell in the water.
That red spot is blocked by a stone.
The ripples move. I swim over.

lines.zh: 找到刚才那朵花的位置。
lines.en: I find where that flower landed.
Come to me, and die not.

lines.zh: 我头顶那点红，是这片水的标记。
lines.en: The red on my head marks this pond as mine.

lines.zh: 红顶对准你，尾巴绷紧了。
lines.en: My red crown aims at you, tail drawn tight.
You can only wait for death.
I have no teeth. I can only stare.
My red crown is a warning color.
Any closer and I dive into the weeds.
I patrol this stretch of river.
You cannot outrun me in water.
I know every stone in this pond.
I follow until the water gets shallow.
All I can do is butt you with my head.
Two splashes to show my displeasure.
I leap out and fall back in.
A streak of red appears in the blossom pond.
I poke my head out from under a lily pad.
This pond has gone strangely quiet.
My red crown breaks the surface like a lamp.
Within sixteen blocks, no monster dares come.
New water, new moss, and me.
A petal lands on my scales.
In the shallows, I slowly take shape.

lines.zh: 水面烫起来，红顶都缩了。
lines.en: The water heats up and my red crown shrinks back.

lines.zh: 头顶一点红，被箭擦破了。
lines.en: An arrow scraped the red crown on my head.

lines.zh: 头顶那点红，被法术打疼了。
lines.en: The red on my head stings from the spell.
